footnote_text: Consists of performance-based restricted stock units ("PRSUs"). Each PRSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of Class A common stock. The PRSUs are divided into nine tranches, each of which will be earned only upon achievement of specified performance objectives during an eight-year performance period. Any tranche earned before the third anniversary of the grant date will vest following such third anniversary subject to the Reporting Person's continued service through such third anniversary, and any tranche earned thereafter will vest upon certification by the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors of the Issuer.
